column1: # Gap 278's bounded remedy: the (function, jurisdiction) -> verdict table AS DATA.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS.  P764: `algorithm0r/canvas-lms-mcp` is MIT and exposes grading,
# comments and rubrics.  It clears every licence check this KB has ever written and is
# GATED-to-PROHIBITED in several jurisdictions.  A licence-only shelf keeps admitting
# architectures that cannot be deployed.  Passes 59 and 60 wrote the two-axis pre-flight as
# PROSE in `compose/patterns.md`; prose is not readable by an instrument, so this is the data.
# BAND -- READ THIS BEFORE CITING ANY ROW.  Every row is `reported`, and that is not
# modesty, it is a measured property of the channel (Gap 270, re-posed pass 61):
#   - 12 of 12 primary policy hosts answer 000 to curl, AND so do example.com, google.com
#     and wikipedia, while raw.githubusercontent.com / pypi / npm answer 200.  The proxy
#     names the mechanism itself: `connect_rejected`, "gateway answered 403 to CONNECT".
#   - WebFetch against the same hosts returns EGRESS_BLOCKED.
#   So this session has exactly ONE regulatory channel -- a search backend's server-side
#   fetch -- and ZERO direct-fetch channels.  No row here can be payload-read, and no row
#   can be cross-checked against a second INDEPENDENT oracle.  A `verified` band on a
#   policy row in this KB would therefore be a defect, today and in any session that
#   measures the same egress policy.
# VERDICT vocabulary.  DECLARED CLOSED AT FIVE VALUES, AND THE DATA HAS CARRIED MORE THAN FIVE
# SINCE PASS 269.  p270 reconciles the header to the data rather than leaving a filter to
# discover the drift at runtime.  This is the same defect class as T29: a statement ABOUT the
# file disagreed with the file, and the statement was the thing being trusted.
#   -- the original five --
#   PROHIBITED           - the function may not be deployed at all
#   GATED                - deployable subject to named obligations (assessment, oversight, logging)
#   MANDATED             - the jurisdiction REQUIRES the function be taught/performed
#   PROPOSED             - a bill or draft, not in force; never plan against this
#   UNREGULATED          - searched and nothing specific found.  An informed gap, not a green light.
#   -- in the data since p269, undeclared until p270 --
#   NONE_IN_FORCE        - an instrument EXISTED and is abrogated/withdrawn.  Not the same as
#                          UNREGULATED: something was repealed, so do not read it as a greenfield.
#   ADOPTED              - a policy or strategy is adopted.  NOT a binding obligation on a
#                          deliverable; pairs with a separate function row for what actually binds.
#   IN_FORCE_UNENFORCED  - law is in force and enforcement is absent or suspended.  Scope the
#                          engagement on ADOPTION risk, not penalty risk (KR by grace period,
#                          JP by statutory design -- same value, different mechanism, see notes).
#   -- also in the data, undeclared, found by COUNTING the column instead of reading the header --
#   HIGH_RISK            - the instrument classifies the function as high-risk WITHOUT yet
#                          naming the obligations.  Weaker than GATED, which names them.
#                          Sole occupant: VN assessment_grading under Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg --
#                          and see that row's UNRECONCILED note, p269: VN carries TWO instruments
#                          for this one (function, jurisdiction) and no shelf has reconciled them.
#   FRAMEWORK_LAUNCHED   - a competency//capability framework is published by or with the
#                          ministry.  Implies a TEACHER-FACING deliverable, not a compliance one.
#                          Sole occupant: EG teacher_competency (UNESCO + MoETE, 2026-06-03).
#   -- added by p270, because five of its rows had no honest home in the ten above --
#   ADVISORY_NONBINDING  - a NAMED, DATED, non-binding instrument exists: voluntary framework,
#                          "strongly recommends", encouraged principles, national priority.
#                          THE MOST COMMON STATE IN THIS FIELD and the one the original five
#                          could not express: UNREGULATED would claim nothing was found, which
#                          is false and reads as a green light; MANDATED would invent a duty.
#   NOT_ESTABLISHED      - this base LOOKED and could not establish the row.  Distinct from
#                          UNREGULATED, which asserts the jurisdiction has no rule; this asserts
#                          only that WE do not know, and names the query that would settle it.
#   -- added by p271, because NOT_ESTABLISHED was carrying two verdicts under one label (T35) --
#   MANDATED_FUTURE_COMMENCEMENT
#                        - the duty is ENACTED/ADOPTED with a NAMED FUTURE commencement date, and
#                          is NOT yet binding today.  Distinct from MANDATED (binding now) and from
#                          PROPOSED (a draft that may never commence, and whose entry says "never
#                          plan against this" -- advice that is WRONG for this state: a dated
#                          commencement is precisely what you plan a procurement runway against).
#                          The `effective` column carries the commencement date, NOT today's status.
#                          Sole occupant: NL ai_literacy_instruction, kerndoelen digitale
#                          geletterdheid, official 2027-08-01, Inspectie oversight from 2031.
#   -- p272 NARROWS this definition, because p271 predicted the liability and it is real. --
#   p271 closed by asking: "MANDATED_FUTURE_COMMENCEMENT has one occupant. Sweep the existing
#   PROPOSED and ADOPTED rows: any instrument with a named future commencement is mis-shelved."
#   THE SWEEP WAS RUN (p272).  RESULT: MEASURED NIL.  Every PROPOSED row carries `effective` = "-"
#   and every ADOPTED row carries a PAST date, so NOT ONE row is mis-shelved.  Recorded as a
#   negative result rather than left as an open worry.
#   BUT the sweep found the real defect, which was not where p271 was looking.  Filtering ALL
#   rows by future `effective` date returns SEVEN, and SIX of them are NOT this value:
#       EMEA EU   assessment_grading / admissions_access / learning_path_steering /
#                 proctoring_behaviour       GATED     eff 2027-12-02
#       EMEA EU-public-sector fundamental_rights_assessment  MANDATED  eff 2027-12-02
#       APAC VN   assessment_grading         HIGH_RISK eff 2027-03-01
#       EMEA NL   ai_literacy_instruction    MANDATED_FUTURE_COMMENCEMENT  eff 2027-08-01
#   🔴 So "binding on a named future date" already had FIVE spellings in this column before p271
#   added a sixth.  `MANDATED` + eff=2027-12-02 (the EU public-sector row) says exactly what
#   `MANDATED_FUTURE_COMMENCEMENT` + eff=2027-08-01 says -- and the `effective` column already
#   carries the date in BOTH.  Encoding commencement in the VERDICT duplicates a column.
#   🟢 NARROWED DEFINITION, which is what makes the value non-redundant: use it ONLY where the
#   INSTRUMENT ITSELF IS NOT YET ADOPTED (draft / "concept") and a commencement date has
#   nonetheless been officially named.  That is precisely the Dutch case -- the kerndoelen are a
#   "definitief concept", not enacted law, with 2027-08-01 named -- and it is precisely NOT the EU
#   AI Act, which is ADOPTED LAW with a deferred application date.
#   🔵 The dimension this column was missing is INSTRUMENT STATUS (draft vs adopted), which is
#   independent of commencement timing.  Two independent dimensions were being crammed into one
#   categorical.  Until a status column exists, the narrowed definition above is the discriminator,
#   and the EU/VN rows are CORRECT as they stand -- adopted instruments, deferred application.
# 🔴 ANY FILTER OR COMPILER READING THIS FILE MUST HANDLE THIRTEEN VALUES, NOT FIVE.
# (p272 re-verified: 13 declared, 13 present, zero undeclared, re-counted AFTER its edits.)  The count
# was reached by `cut -f4 | sort -u` on the data, NOT by reading this header -- which is the only
# method that found HIGH_RISK and FRAMEWORK_LAUNCHED at all.  A consumer
# that switches on the original five will silently drop every ZA, KR, JP, NC, EE, FI, NL, SG,
# ID, CO, CL, BR and regional row -- i.e. most of the non-US-state coverage this base has.
# REGION vocabulary (closed, five values, per the KB-wide convention):
#   North America | EMEA | APAC | LATAM | Global

column1: APAC
column7: p331 RECONCILIATION CLOSED. The premise of the p269 conflict was wrong: Decree 142/2026/ND-CP and Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg do not compete, they COMPOSE. Decree 142 is the FRAMEWORK (risk tiers + provider self-classification duty, eff. 2026-04-30); Decision 33 is the LIST that framework refers to (46 high-risk AI systems across 6 sectors; signed 2026-06-30, eff. 2026-08-15). Both dates brief TOGETHER. The 'two dates' were one date and its own grace period: general compliance 2027-03-01, PLUS six months for healthcare/education/finance systems already in operation before 2026-08-15 = 2027-09-01, which two independent sources this pass state directly. 2027-09-01 is the date to put in a plan. EDUCATION carries THREE entries: (1) large-scale self-study content generation built on uncontrolled data [NEW p331]; (2) automated testing/ranking where the result counts as the official outcome; (3) biometric or emotion monitoring of learners. Entry 2 bites ONLY where AI output is the sole basis without meaningful human review - a human-in-the-loop design keeps the product out of the high-risk class (see Trend 20, patterns P26). Conformity has TWO pathways specified per system: mandatory third-party certification before deployment, OR provider self-assessment/approved body - which pathway each education entry draws is the open unknown. CAVEAT: per-entry wording and per-entry pathway are from secondary summaries plus a truncated official text; instrument number, 2026-06-30, 2026-08-15, 46/6 and 2027-09-01 each carry two or more independent sources. Primary: thuvienphapluat.vn, english.luatvietnam.vn.

column1: EMEA
column7: p271 OVERTURNS p270's NOT_ESTABLISHED. p270 retracted the Netherlands and wrote "Costed next step, NOT run: Dutch-language queries against the Ministerie van OCW and SLO"; p271 RAN them and the instrument exists. AI-geletterdheid is EXPLICITLY included in the new kerndoelen digitale geletterdheid. Scope: primair onderwijs + onderbouw vo + (voortgezet) speciaal onderwijs -- i.e. the PRIMARY band, which is Gap 367 territory. STATUS TODAY IS CONCEPT ("definitief concept" Jul 2025; functional kerndoelen Nov 2025); officially in force 2027-08-01; fully introduced with Inspectie oversight 2031. Three domains, the practical one including AI exploration (recognise AI in own surroundings, how it works, social/ethical consequences). DO NOT brief the Netherlands as a current K-12 AI leader: that aggregator claim (same sentence as the $2.64B EMEA figure, see T33) remains UNSUPPORTED -- no Dutch deployment at Estonia's measured scale was located. The instrument is a DATED RUNWAY, not a deployment. One secondary source (go21) expected 2026 nationwide introduction and is OUTDATED; Kennisnet and the Expertisepunt both give Aug 2027. Secondary-source grade (primary channel unreachable, re-tested p271).
